verdict.rationale: Working Copy ships its own conversational Repository Agent that can read and modify files, commit, pull and push. That covers the AI-agent-makes-changes core, but nothing documents assigning an issue to it or having it open a ready-to-review pull request; the workflow is interactive chat, not delegated issue-to-PR. missing for 10: issue assignment to the agent, agent-created pull requests, asynchronous/delegated execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can assign an issue to an AI coding agent and receive a ready-to-review pull request

citations.quote: Repository Agent is an AI assistant that you interact with through conversation. Ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push.
